title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 96
paragraphs: When they reached Naxos, coming at it across the Icarian Sea — for it was against Naxos that the Persians intended to strike first, remembering their earlier failure — the Naxians fled at once into the mountains and did not wait to resist. The Persians enslaved those they caught and set fire to the sanctuaries and to the town. That done, they put to sea to attack the other islands.
